entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to start?

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. It looks like it was delivered 62 days ago. To proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The color is not what I expected. At all.
I understand. So just to be clear, there are no issues with the fit or any of the safety features? It's just the aesthetic?
It's fine. The box is still unopened, not that you probably care.
No, that's helpful information, thank you. Let me just pull up our return policy for you... one moment.

Okay, thanks for waiting. My system shows that standard items have a 90-day return window. Since you're at day 62, you're well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund.

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the helmet back up, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Whatever. I'll wait for the email.
Perfect. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, Sarah. Have a good day.
